name: Preview Validation
description: Open the preview URL in the shared Browser session and confirm the expected application loaded. A running process is not a preview.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the preview URL in the shared Browser session.
Check that the URL responds before opening it.
Follow a redirect in the same session.
Record the final URL and title evidence.

validation.rule: The preview is marked reachable only after browser_open and browser_screenshot show the expected application. A started process is not marked as a preview.
